isolation: No journey save API or player progress writes
procedure: Record phone model, OS and browser version, screen brightness, low power mode, charging state and room light.
Choose combat view, Auto quality and 100% brightness. Keep the tab visible.
Start the measurement: 30 seconds of warmup followed by 60 seconds of collection. Export diagnostic JSON.
Repeat Performance (low) and boss view in both portrait and landscape.
Play for 15 minutes, note heat and control responsiveness, then repeat the warm measurements.
Record visual defects and interruptions. Repeat interrupted measurements.
timing: Rendered-frame interval, the immediately preceding rAF interval, and CPU simulation/render submission duration are separate measurements. GPU timing is unavailable. Loading, warmup, pause and intentional hit pause retain separate classifications.
memory: Asset texture and render target color estimates are separate. Decoded images, depth, driver allocations and transient upload peaks remain unmeasured.
acceptance: Use results from actual physical devices. Desktop rendering or a resized viewport does not verify phone performance.
